correctness.rationale: For an arbitrary cyclic m-point list in convex H, Keller Lemma 3.3 proves the signed shoelace bound F≤area(H) on every 3–5 point list without simple-polygon assumptions. For m≥6 remove P1,P2,P3 to form (P0,P4,…,P_{m−1}); the exact determinant telescoping identity F(P)−F(Q)=F(P0,P1,P2,P3,P4) yields F(P)≤area(H)+F(Q). Induction gives floor(m/3)area(H); reversing the list obtains |F|. Taking an H-triangle and tracing its A,B,C loop q=floor(m/3) times, inserting r=m−3q repeated vertices, attains q area(H) exactly for every m. This also covers repeated/degenerate locations and area-zero H; the theorem is signed area, not unsigned self-intersecting lobe area. Checked the exact cancellation identity and equality construction directly from determinant algebra, not logs.

The submitted all-m optimal unconstrained factor floor(m/3), with every residue class attained, is not in the inspected source. Fáry–Makai edge-vector convexification does not maintain vertex containment in H and therefore does not yield this area(H) coefficient.
